moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Still UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the Official UK Singles Chart top spot for an unprecedented 23rd week, but its reign might be ending soon.

angles.name: Longest Reign
angles.copy: 23 weeks at Number 1 and still going strong! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are making history with 'Rein Me In'. Is it the greatest chart run ever?

angles.name: Who's Next?
angles.copy: After 23 weeks, is Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' finally about to lose the top spot? What track do YOU think deserves to knock them off?

angles.name: Chart-topping Duo
angles.copy: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean: a match made in chart heaven! 'Rein Me In' continues its record-breaking run. What a collaboration!

moments.title: Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' Re-Enters Top 10
moments.blurb: The iconic 'Jolene' by Dolly Parton has made a surprise re-entry into the Official UK Singles Chart Top 10, proving its timeless appeal.

angles.name: Timeless Classic
angles.copy: Jolene, Jolene, Jolene, Joooleene! Dolly Parton's classic is back in the UK Top 10! Some songs just never get old.

angles.name: Chart Surprise
angles.copy: What a comeback! Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' is a Top 10 hit again. Who saw that coming? What other classics deserve a chart re-entry?
